task.title: Advance workflows through task Verification
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/779 with a stale-safe boundary that advances one task attributed workflow through an authored gate backed by exact identified Verification evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Map the caller-selected authored transition gate to one exact task Verification check for one supplied Attempt.
Advance only after passed evidence and return typed pending, failed, lineage, attribution, and ungated rejections without writes.
Re-evaluate task evidence after task stream races while keeping the caller's workflow revision authoritative.
Preserve the existing advancement event, replay compatibility, and raw caller-acknowledgement API.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-run test failed because advance_if_task_verification_passes did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added success, pending, failed, invalid-lineage, unattributed, ungated, task race, and workflow-race tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Separating gate evaluation from append would authorize from stale task evidence, so both observed stream revisions had to participate in the persistence boundary.
attempts.patch: Added typed preparation and rejection, exact Attempt and check evaluation, guarded append with task reload, ADR-0032, and lifecycle documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found ADR-0010 still claimed no evidence binding existed; substantive review also found awkward gate-identity wording.
attempts.patch: Added an explicit historical follow-on note, clarified that the authored gate becomes the single identified Verification check, reran verification, and resolved the review thread.

outcome.summary: A task attributed workflow can advance through one caller-selected authored gate only when exact identified Verification passes, without stale task evidence reinterpreting exact workflow intent.

lessons: Evidence authorization and its guarded workflow append must share exact task and workflow revision checks.
Task evidence races may be re-evaluated, but phase-relative workflow intent must remain bound to the caller's exact revision.
Historical ADRs need explicit follow-on notes when later additive boundaries supersede deferred capability statements.
A gate identity names required evidence; it does not execute a verifier or grant permission.
